'''Terra Velasquez''' is an [[Engineers|Odyssey Engineer]] based at '''Rascal's Choice''' in the '''Shou Xing''' system. After rejecting a wealthy upbringing and spending a decade imprisoned following a failed heist, she established an independent workshop specialising in suit mobility, endurance, weapon handling, and stealth.<ref name="inara-terra">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/31/ Terra Velasquez — Engineer], INARA; current access, location, services, and referral record. Retrieved 12 September 2026.</ref><ref name="fandom-terra">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Terra_Velasquez Terra Velasquez], Elite Dangerous Wiki; in-game biography. Retrieved 12 September 2026.</ref>

Terra is the second Engineer in the Jude Navarro branch and provides the direct referral to [[Oden Geiger]].

Rascal's Choice is a surface Engineer base on Shou Xing 1, approximately 411 Ls from the system arrival point.<ref name="inara-rascals-choice">[https://inara.cz/elite/station/315179/ Rascal's Choice — Station], INARA; current facility and location record. Retrieved 12 September 2026.</ref>

== Access requirements ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Stage
! Requirement
|-
| Discovery
| Receive a referral from [[Jude Navarro]] after providing him with '''5 Genetic Repair Meds'''.
|-
| Unlock
| Complete a combined total of '''6 Covert Theft and/or Covert Heist missions'''.
|}

The six missions may be drawn from either qualifying type; ordinary Theft, Heist, Larceny, and other settlement missions do not automatically count. The complete mission workflow belongs to [[Unlocking Terra Velasquez]].<ref name="inara-terra" />

=== Tracking reliability ===

Frontier's Update 13 notes state that a defect preventing Covert Theft missions from counting toward Terra's prerequisite was fixed.<ref name="frontier-update13">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/elite-dangerous-update-13-notes Elite Dangerous — Update 13 Notes], Frontier Developments; prerequisite-tracking fix. Retrieved 12 September 2026.</ref> More recent Issue Tracker reports from February and August 2026 describe some Commanders still completing six or more qualifying missions without receiving the unlock.<ref name="frontier-terra-83341">[https://issues.frontierstore.net/issue-detail/83341 Terra Velasquez still not unlocking after completing more than 6 covert thefts], Frontier Issue Tracker; report dated 28 February 2026. Retrieved 12 September 2026.</ref><ref name="frontier-terra-87186">[https://issues.frontierstore.net/issue-detail/87186 Trouble Unlocking Terra Velasquez], Frontier Issue Tracker; report dated 13 August 2026. Retrieved 12 September 2026.</ref>

These reports do not establish a different normal requirement. If six missions do not register, confirm that Jude has referred Terra and that the completed missions were explicitly labelled Covert Theft or Covert Heist before assuming that more missions are required.

{{Field note|INARA separately reports that station services may not appear immediately after the workshop is unlocked. Relogging should make them available.<ref name="inara-terra" />}}

== Odyssey Engineering ==

Terra installs individual modifications into available suit and handheld-weapon modification slots. Her services do not use the Grade 1–5 Engineer-reputation progression, blueprint rolls, Experimental Effects, or Remote Engineering used for ship modules. Equipment grade and modification-slot availability are handled through the wider [[Odyssey Engineering]] system.

== Engineering services ==

{| class="wikitable sortable"
! Modification
! Equipment
! Purpose
|-
| Combat Movement Speed
| Suit
| Removes the normal movement-speed penalty while aiming down sights.
|-
| Increased Air Reserves
| Suit
| Extends emergency life-support endurance after suit energy is depleted.
|-
| Increased Sprint Duration
| Suit
| Improves sustained sprint endurance.
|-
| Improved Hip Fire Accuracy
| Handheld weapon
| Improves accuracy when firing without aiming down sights; recipes vary by manufacturer.
|-
| Noise Suppressor
| Handheld weapon
| Reduces weapon sound in pressurised environments.
|}

These five modification types are available once Terra is unlocked, subject to compatible equipment, an open modification slot, and the required Odyssey materials and credits.<ref name="inara-terra" /> Their complete recipes and cross-Engineer availability belong to [[Odyssey Engineer Modifications]].

== Referral to Oden Geiger ==

After unlocking Terra, provide her with '''15 Financial Projections''' to discover [[Oden Geiger]]. This referral requirement is separate from the six missions used to unlock Terra.<ref name="inara-terra" /><ref name="inara-oden">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/34/ Oden Geiger — Engineer], INARA; current discovery prerequisite. Retrieved 12 September 2026.</ref>

<pre>
Jude Navarro
└── Terra Velasquez
    └── Oden Geiger
</pre>

Oden's own unlock conditions belong on [[Oden Geiger]] and in [[Unlocking Oden Geiger]].
